title: Add moeb interview command to produce a specification through guided conversation
description: Authoring a spec requires knowledge of the spec schema, existing conventions, and the README index structure. A user with a clear problem statement but no familiarity with the schema must read documentation before they can author a valid spec. This raises the barrier unnecessarily and means specs authored without guidance often omit rubrics, steps, or links.
proposed_resolution: Implement moeb interview that launches a guided Q&A session via the configured AI adapter and produces a draft spec file from the responses. The interview must cover in sequence: (1) problem statement and motivation, (2) proposed implementation steps, (3) acceptance rubrics, (4) target files and links. The interviewer should ask the most clarifying question first and proceed only when the current answer is sufficient. Output is a draft spec file written to the appropriate specifications directory with status: draft. The spec skill should be invocable on the resulting draft to validate and register it.
